phase: Record alignment/support before scores; semantic protocol fixed in35c4c384ad

HF453.tag_keys: Exact stem.tag values across both original epochs; pure integer leading-zero normalization. Composite tag.stem.tag is considered only as an explicit composite key and never breaks collisions. No tree-tag substitution or outcome/species tie break.
HF453.eligibility: Unique same stem/tree/raw species across E0/E1, E0alive, E1 observed DBH>=10, recorded A/AU2021; prior securely dead E1 conflicts with later alive baseline and is excluded as a biological-identity contradiction.
HF453.duplicates: Exact duplicate rows collapse; nonidentical tag/year duplicate or secure-dead-to-alive reversal excludes entire affected tag; all excluded rows remain ledgered.
HF453.damage_indicator: At baseline any observed numeric FAD,wound,canker,rot,DWR>0 is RECORDED_DAMAGE; all numeric zeros NO_RECORDED_DAMAGE; otherwise UNKNOWN. Notes and uncertain encoded prose never become causal death labels.
HF453.no_later_outcome_selection: Reversal/duplicate flags implement already frozen consistency rule, not prediction-driven pruning

HF355.identity: Exact seedlingID; coordinate/taxon constants required, exact duplicate visits collapse; nonidentical sameID/year duplicate and ID/IH invalid statuses exclude affected identity. Preserve flag=1 separately; flag is not automatically death.
HF355.botanical_crosswalk: Compare raw HF355 taxonCode lower-case to frozen HF253 species code table and verify documented genus/species strings. Codes absent or mismatched retained as explicit unaligned taxa, never guessed aliases.
HF355.date: Strict metadata YYYY-MM-DD; missing or malformed dates excluded from dated transitions, never fabricated. Date-year mismatch explicit ledger.
HF355.canopy: Exact recorded coordinate-to-plot string or integer leading-zero normalization only; unknown links retained. Acquisition timestamps and year are recorded context, never extrapolated to other visits.
HF355.support: Below1cm 1m2 observations have no identified count/entry bridge to original whole-plot1-10cm juvenile carrier. Report descriptive process support; no seedling-specific mortality forecast fitted.

outcomes_already_inspected: Declared status/flag/missingness field support only, after original protocol freeze. No predictive score, hazard refit, cap choice or Health tuning.
outputs: Mandatory alignment_matrix.csv and record-level crosswalk/exclusion ledger plus explicit support status/count certificate; commit before component scores
